description: This source file implements credential storage functionality for Git, including reading, writing, and managing credentials in files with locking. It includes methods for parsing credential files, storing credentials as URLs, and handling credential operations via command-line interface.

methods.name: int parse_credential_file(const char * fn,struct credential * c,void (* match_cb)(struct credential *),void (* other_cb)(struct strbuf *),int match_password)
methods.description: Parses a credential file line by line, invoking callbacks for matched credentials or other lines. Returns 1 if a credential match is found.

methods.name: void print_entry(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Prints the username and password of a credential to standard output.

methods.name: void print_line(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Writes a line buffer to the credential lock file.

methods.name: void rewrite_credential_file(const char * fn,struct credential * c,struct strbuf * extra,int match_password)
methods.description: Rewrites a credential file with updated credentials, using file locking and optional extra data.

methods.name: int is_rfc3986_unreserved(char ch)
methods.description: Checks if a character is an unreserved URI-encoded character according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: int is_rfc3986_reserved_or_unreserved(char ch)
methods.description: Checks if a character is either reserved or unreserved in RFC 3986 URI components.

methods.name: void store_credential_file(const char * fn,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Stores credential information into a specified file, encoding the URL components properly.

methods.name: void store_credential(const struct string_list * fns,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Stores credentials into one of the specified credential files, after validation.

methods.name: void remove_credential(const struct string_list * fns,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Removes or rewrites credentials from specified files based on matching criteria.

methods.name: void lookup_credential(const struct string_list * fns,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Looks up and prints credentials from specified files.

methods.name: int cmd_credential_store(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command function handling the credential store operations: get, erase, store, based on command-line arguments.

ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.pattern: /^static void lookup_credential(const struct string_list *fns, struct credential *c)$/

ctags.signature: (const char * fn,struct credential * c,struct strbuf * extra,int match_password)

ctags.pattern: /^static void store_credential(const struct string_list *fns, struct credential *c)$/
